title: Resolved: featured 50/50 bookmaker tie now runs alias-aware money origination and never triggers an arbitrary strategy upset swap
detail: Independent audit of production deployment 39023111893 (2026-10-17T10:01:13Z, inventory_observed_at 2026-10-17T10:00:21Z) found that Hotspawn fixture 1080207 (FURIA vs Aurora, Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Semifinal #1 at 14:00 UTC) matched Thunderpick's exact-name 1.85 / 1.85 tie ([0.5, 0.5], pick_index: null) in collect.py while missing Polymarket event 1200431 ('FURIA vs Aurora Gaming', bid 0.52/0.47, ask 0.53/0.48 -> 52.5% / 47.5%) and Kalshi KXCS2GAME-26OCT171000AURFURIA (bid 0.52/0.47, ask 0.53/0.48 -> 52.5% / 47.5%). Because featured.get('method') != 'model', originate.py previously skipped alias-aware money origination for 1080207, and build_strategy.py defaulted fav=0 / dog=1 on that 50/50 tie and promoted Aurora to an 'Upset play' (cost 0.0). Both defects are now fixed: originate.py upgrades a featured tie when alias-aware research verifies a directional money-backed line, and build_strategy.py keeps any true 50/50 (pick_index: null) row ineligible for upset swaps with no directional default.
